claim.text: All decisions/trades/intents/broker state retained. Consumed signal trace rows periodically removed after aggregate capture; analytics signal counts are not used.

correction: The runner uses actual SQLite intent/quarantine tables causally during evaluation, but the final result JSON exports only selected snapshot fields. Complete intent/quarantine table rows are not retained after isolated-database cleanup.

retainedTradingEvidence.persistedTrades: Complete exported trades rows, including broker-backed entry/close reconciliation payloads
retainedTradingEvidence.brokerLedger: Broker execution/protection/financing ledger; quote-observation trace rows suppressed
retainedTradingEvidence.summary: Economic, cadence, modeled observation and accounting reductions; only the last 15 entry decisions are duplicated in summary.finalDecisions
retainedTradingEvidence.equityDailyAndTradeObservations: All recorded model equity observations despite the broad legacy field name

notExported.otherSnapshotState: The entire broker checkpoint, entire event stream and all SQLite snapshot tables are not serialized. This is not a complete historical database export.

causalScope: Intent and quarantine handling occurs through the actual coordinator/engine/repositories in the isolated replay. This erratum changes no runtime call, quote, rule, eligibility, trade, accounting value or source pin.
auditLimits: Export-based parity and independent reducers validate the selected serialized economic/decision/trade/episode-state evidence. They cannot independently compare or audit complete hidden intent/quarantine rows after cleanup.
Software integration tests exercise actual intent/lifecycle behavior; passing them does not supply missing historical table exports.
Consumed signal trace rows are removed periodically after aggregate capture, and quote-only broker trace rows are suppressed. Neither forms a complete tick/signal archive.
disposition: Preserve frozen r3 executable source and results. Correct review wording and link this erratum. No restart or strategy behavior change is justified by this export wording issue.
